summary: Northwesterly offshore winds today will keep the rip current risk subdued. Weak winds are expected Monday and most of Tuesday, before northeast winds pick up Tuesday night behind a back door cold front. That will kick up the rip risk on Wednesday for Franklin County beaches. Another cold front on Wednesday will bring a shift to westerly winds, which could pick up the rip risk for Panhandle beaches Thursday.
